title: Red Lions on White
coreRelationships: The two red lions are the primary subjects, creating a dynamic diagonal axis.
The stark white background provides high contrast for the red lions and their dark shadows.
The dark shadows beneath the lions create a strong sense of three-dimensionality and ground the figures.
The text in the upper left corner acts as a clear, contrasting title element against the minimalist background.
